responsibility: Defines the core trait-resolution data model shared across `rustc_middle`: obligation causes and their reporting context, trait-selection result types re-exported from submodules, and compiler-facing enums/structs that describe why obligations arise, how dyn-compatibility violations are classified, and how codegen-time trait resolution failures are represented.
same_name_distinction: Unlike query-oriented or helper trait files such as `traits/query.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the root shared traits data layer: it defines compiler-facing trait-resolution concepts like `Reveal`, `ObligationCause`, and object-safety violation categories, while re-exporting selection-side results.
